ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Near-zero macro-level contrast ratio; visible surface is >98% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) with high-intensity pixels localized only to specular water reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity distribution; absence of distinct contiguous high-contrast geometric blobs or pigmentation mottling on the visible ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 120 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medium-frequency, irregular serrations; pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels occurring at intervals of 20-40 pixels along the trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; initial convexity extending from the median notch transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes and along the anterior-superior margin of the left lobe lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe at approximately 40% distance from the median notch to the tip; focal white scarring on the distal extremities.
